title: San Diego Baby in Walker, Wooden Wheel Cart - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Ruth-
O'Conna Byrne - 7 mo.
4789- 70TH -- S.D.
Sept 1937
PANEL-ART SNAPSHOTS
APR 28 1938
BUNNELL PHOTO SHOP
SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA
Daughter of:-
Ruth Herrick Byrne
And
Daniel A. Byrne
description: A charming Depression-era outdoor snapshot capturing seven-month-old O'Conna Byrne seated happily in a vintage metal baby stroller/walker (resembling a classic Taylor Tot). She is dressed in a light-colored dress and posed in the dappled shade beneath a slender tree, right next to a tilted wooden cart with spoked wooden wheels. Handwritten notes on the back identify her as the daughter of Ruth Herrick Byrne and Daniel A. Byrne of 70th Street in San Diego, California. The print features rounded inner photo corners from Bunnell Photo Shop's Panel-Art Snapshots process.
